title: Drizzle data layer: dual-driver schema (SQLite/Postgres)
description: Create the Drizzle ORM schema (players, ships, cargo_items, sessions, resource_node_state, system_registry) that compiles against both better-sqlite3 (local) and Postgres (prod), with migrations and a repository interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema in `src/server/db/schema.ts` defines all six tables exactly per PRD §8 (field names, types, constraints): players (id uuid pk, callsign unique, credits int default 500, home_system_id, created_at), ships (id uuid pk, owner_id fk, class_id, livery json, hull real, shields real, position json, velocity json, state enum docked|flying|onfoot|destroyed, updated_at), cargo_items (id pk, ship_id fk, resource_type, quantity, unique(ship_id, resource_type)), sessions (token_hash pk, player_id fk, system_id nullable, created_at, expires_at), resource_node_state (node_id pk, quantity_remaining, respawn_at nullable), system_registry (system_id pk, name, shard_active, last_active_at)
Driver selected by DB_DRIVER env: sqlite (default, file at DB_PATH) or postgres (DATABASE_URL); both compile from the same schema definition
Migrations for the SQLite driver run cleanly on a fresh file (migrate in tests); Postgres parity verified by schema-compile test (drizzle-kit generate for pg produces DDL without error)

Repository interface (`src/server/db/repo.ts`): createPlayer, findPlayerByCallsign, getOrCreateStarterShip, saveShipState, saveCargo, addCredits/withdrawCredits, upsertNodeState, listNodeStates(systemId), session CRUD — implemented generically over the driver
Unit tests (vitest, sqlite in tmp dir): full CRUD round-trip per repository method; unique callsign violation raises typed error; insufficient-credits withdraw raises typed error

steps.details: Use drizzle-orm/sqlite-core and drizzle-orm/pg-core with a shared column-definition approach (define each table once with driver-agnostic types where possible; where types diverge, use a small buildTable(driver) helper). UUIDs: text pk (crypto.randomUUID()). Enums as text with check constraints (sqlite) / pg enum (postgres).
src/server/db/client.ts: read DB_DRIVER; sqlite -> better-sqlite3 file (mkdir -p dirname), migrate() on boot; postgres -> pg Pool from DATABASE_URL. Export `db` and `migrate()`.

Generate SQLite migration SQL (hand-written or drizzle-kit); store in src/server/db/migrations/*.sql; apply sequentially with a _migrations tracking table. Add drizzle.config.ts for pg DDL generation (used by CI parity test).
Implement every method in the interface with parameterized queries only (no string concatenation of user input). Typed errors: CallsignTakenError, InsufficientCreditsError, NotFoundError.
Unit tests per method against a tmp sqlite file. CI parity: a test that runs drizzle-kit generate for postgres to a temp dir and asserts it exits 0 (no live PG needed). Run full suite green.

technicalNotes: Only mutable state is ever stored — geometry stays derived from the seed (PRD §8). Do not add tables for stars/planets/terrain.
position/velocity/livery are JSON columns: store plain objects; validate shapes with zod at the repository boundary.
